missingTitle: Some details are missing — the document will have blank lines:
templatesText: Document design is fixed (header, services table, company details and signatures). Only the text can be changed here.
proposalNote: Note at the end of the proposal
proposalNoteHint: E.g.: prices exclude VAT; payment in UZS at the Central Bank rate on the payment date
contractTemplateHint: “# ” — title, “## ” — section, [[services]] — services table, [[parties]] — parties’ details and signatures
placeholdersText: Click to insert into the text at the cursor position.
blocksText: An empty field becomes a “________” line in the document — it can be filled in by hand.
resetConfirm: Replace the contract text with the default template? Changes take effect after saving.
companyText: Used in proposals and contracts. Edited in company settings.

missing.companyBank: Company bank, MFO bank code and account number
missing.companySigner: Company: “represented by …” in the Russian genitive case, used in the Russian contract text (директора Иванова И.И.)
missing.clientLegalName: Client legal name (client profile → Company details)
missing.clientSigner: Client: “represented by …” in the Russian genitive case (Russian contract text)
